name: CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CySA+)

fee.note: US list price for one CySA+ voucher on CompTIA's store. Vouchers are country and currency specific, so the price differs by country. The same page lists a voucher with Retake Assurance at $579 and CertMaster bundles with a voucher from $593.

exam.format: Up to 85 multiple-choice and performance-based questions in 165 minutes. English, with French, Japanese, Spanish and Portuguese announced as coming soon. CompTIA recommends about four years of hands-on experience as a SOC analyst (level 2) or vulnerability analyst; it is a recommendation, not a prerequisite.

scope: Security operations center (SOC) analysis: detecting and analyzing malicious activity, vulnerability management, incident response and management, and reporting and communication.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: CS0-004 (V4) launched on June 23, 2026. CS0-003 (V3) retires in English on December 22, 2026, and in Japanese, Portuguese and Spanish on March 23, 2027; its domains and weights differ (Security Operations 33%, Vulnerability Management 30%, Incident Response Management 20%, Reporting and Communication 17%). Buy the voucher for the version you will sit: CompTIA vouchers are exam series specific and sometimes exam code specific.
Renewal: the certification lasts three years. Renew with 60 CEUs plus a $150 CE fee per three-year cycle, by passing the latest version of the exam, or with some higher-level CompTIA certifications.
